version: Basel Framework CRE52, the standardised approach for counterparty credit risk: its supervisory numbers, each beside the paragraph it is read from

cites.multiplier_floor: CRE52.23: Floor is 5%; CRE52.22: the multiplier is floored at 5% of the PFE add-on
cites.supervisory: CRE52.72, Table 2: the supervisory factor, correlation and supervisory option volatility of each asset class and subclass, N/A a null; the vol is the delta's of CRE52.40(2), the correlation the single-factor weight of CRE52.61(4), CRE52.66(4) and CRE52.70(5)
cites.interest_rate.buckets: CRE52.57(3): less than one year, between one and five years, more than five years, by the end date E of CRE52.31(3)
cites.interest_rate.correlations: CRE52.57(5): EN = (D1^2 + D2^2 + D3^2 + 1.4 D1 D2 + 1.4 D2 D3 + 0.6 D1 D3)^(1/2), each cross term twice the correlation of its two buckets
cites.maturity.business_days: CRE52.49 and CRE52.53: 250 business days in a year
cites.maturity.floor: CRE52.48 and CRE52.49: M floored at ten business days, 10/250 years; CRE52.34: SD floored at ten business days
cites.maturity.mpor.bilateral: CRE52.50(1): ten business days for non-centrally-cleared transactions under daily margin
cites.maturity.mpor.cleared: CRE52.50(3): the floors CRE54 prescribes for centrally cleared transactions, five business days as the FAQ to CRE52.32 counts the shortest; not read, a netting set stating no clearing
cites.maturity.mpor.large_set: CRE52.51(1): 20 business days for a netting set of more than 5,000 transactions not with a central counterparty
cites.maturity.mpor.disputed: CRE52.51(3): the floor doubled after more than two margin call disputes over two quarters; not read, a netting set stating no dispute history
cites.commodity_sets: CRE52.45(5) and CRE52.70 step 2, the four hedging sets, and Table 2's subclasses: a SIMM commodity bucket to the hedging set and subclass it is held in, our declaration - coal, crude, the distillates and gas to energy at Oil/Gas, Table 2's energy row beside electricity; power to energy at Electricity; the metals to metals; grains, softs and livestock to agricultural; freight, other and indexes to other
cites.option_shift: CRE52.40, FAQ2: per currency the shift lambda added to P and K of every interest rate option in it, in percent as a rate option's strike is stated, none where a currency states none
